input.quote: 13. NON-SOLICITATION OF EMPLOYEES. Neither party shall, during the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year after its termination, solicit for hire as an employee, consultant or otherwise any of the other party's personnel who have had direct involvement with the Services, without such other party's express written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, field-of-use, exclusivity or territory restriction binding Clear Capital. Searches for "compete/competing", "exclusive", "Company shall not", "restrict" and "develop", plus full review of the engagement scope (§1), termination/survival (§6) and the general provisions (§7), turned up only: (i) a mutual employee non-solicit (p0047) that binds both parties equally and is not a restraint on the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build; (ii) an IP-scope limit in p0020 barring resale or use of Contractor's pre-existing proprietary materials outside the software we receive, which is ordinary licence-scope drafting rather than a restrictive covenant; and (iii) p0019, which confirms Contractor may serve other clients and imposes nothing on us. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is warranted.
